method: Adjudicated the 13 u-west disputes from the drawing, not by majority. Each spot was rendered zoomed in (0.1-0.5 m grid) and its primitives were queried from prims.pkl (layer, linetype, exact end points). Kept the 11 accepted openings; the drawing contradicted none of them (checked the UW-07 vestibule box and the UW-09 portal box: both are HIDDEN2 outlines, not solid). Main calls: (1) Measurement: a and b go on the wall centre line at the structural wall-end faces, frames included. D-JAMB cladding round piers is ignored (as in accepted UW-10). WALL nibs that pack a door frame out to the wall end are included (UW-03). (2) Glass, under the 26 Oct definition (sill height irrelevant; a glass wall is glazing not set in a gap of a wall line). The bridge sides are glazed corridor walls, so glassWalls. The closet panel (UW-15), the stair-hall glass (UW-18) and the void corner glazing (UW-16/17) sit in gaps of real wall lines between wall ends, piers and columns, so windows; the elevation draws them like every upper window (0-2.60 m, wall to the 2.90 ceiling). (3) Kind of the bedroom west bay (UW-01): a FLOOR-outlined deck with a curb and a glass balustrade, versus the TREE-outlined planter outside UW-05, so door with eitherKind. (4) The shower door is in a single-line glass screen, so rejected and the screen listed as a glass wall. E's two corridor gaps are the corridor itself, so rejected. The two gaps beside the free-standing closet stub are passage mouths, so optional. Final check: a sweep of every WIN, WALL-GL, D-JAMB and door-layer primitive and every arc larger than 0.3 m in the box; each lies within 0.35 m of a final opening or glass wall, or is explained (furniture, the shower door block, door leaves swinging away from their wall line, pier cladding, a garden tree, the UW-11 pocket panel, the wing south cladding). Two marked renders (check_wing.png, check_main.png) show no unmarked swing, leaf, jamb pair, window band or clean wall gap.
